Gold.note: Central bank buying and rate cut expectations support prices despite recent strong gains.

Silver.note: Robust solar panel demand and monetary premium drive outperformance over gold.

Copper.note: Structural mine supply deficits and strong green energy demand underpin high prices.

Uranium.note: Structural primary supply deficit and renewed global nuclear capacity build.

Lithium.note: Near-term supply surplus and moderating EV battery demand growth weigh on sentiment.

Nickel.note: Surging Indonesian supply growth outpaces sluggish global stainless steel demand.

Zinc.note: Tight concentrate supply and global smelter production cuts support strong prices.

Iron Ore.note: Weak Chinese property construction offsets resilient but capped steel export demand.

Coal.note: Peaking thermal coal demand in Asia offsets steady met coal fundamentals.

Rare Earths.note: Chinese export controls balance against steady electric vehicle motor demand.

Manganese.note: Softening global steel production margins limit upside potential for battery and alloy grades.

PGM.note: Hydrogen economy potential and constrained South African supply support the basket.

Potash.note: Steady global agricultural application rates balance normalizing post-shock supply.

Aluminum.note: Chinese smelter capacity caps and strong lightweighting demand tighten the market.

Diversified.note: Balanced exposure to iron ore weakness and copper strength yields a neutral outlook.
